hero.title: Zone Management Runbook
hero.subtitle: Operational guide for managing infrastructure zones in the controlplane

warning.title: Zone is Root Topology
warning.desc: Zone is the root infrastructure unit. All dataplane nodes, services, and workloads are anchored to a zone. Changes to zone status or services have blast radius across all workloads running on that zone. Always follow the runbook and have a rollback plan.

create.title: Creating a New Zone
prereq: Admin API key with valid MFA
Zone code must be unique (e.g. us-east-1, edge-hcm-1)
Geographic location must be selected from the autocomplete list
At least one service must be enabled
steps: Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Add Zone
Fill in zone name, zone code, and geographic location
Select at least one enabled service (see Section 3 for service details)
Zone is created with status planned
create.note: New zones always start in planned status. Status cannot be set during creation. Transition to active only after dataplane registration is complete.

transitions.title: Zone Status Transitions

states.label: PLANNED
states.note: Initial state — zone created, dataplane not yet registered

states.label: ACTIVE
states.note: Serving traffic — dataplane registered and healthy

states.label: DRAINING
states.note: No new workloads — existing workloads finishing

states.label: MAINTENANCE
states.note: No traffic — services can be updated

transitions.label: Graceful drain — no new workloads accepted
Disable zone — all workloads must be migrated first

how_to: Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone
Select target status from the dropdown (only valid transitions are shown)
Monitor zone status in real-time on the zone detail page
transitions.warning: Transitioning any zone to disabled stops all traffic immediately. Ensure all workloads are migrated to another zone before proceeding.

services.title: Managing Zone Services
table: Requires dataplane node with hypervisor capability
Requires dataplane node with storage capability
Requires SMTP relay configured on dataplane
Requires dataplane node with k8s capability
Requires dataplane node with GPU capability
services.when: Zone services can only be modified when the zone is in planned or maintenance status.
workflow: If zone is active, transition to maintenance first
Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone → Services
Toggle the target service enabled / disabled
Transition zone back to active when ready
services.drain_note: Drain all workloads and update status: active → maintenance
services.warning: Disabling a service while workloads are running on it will cause immediate service disruption. Always drain workloads from the affected service before disabling it.

deletion.title: Deleting a Zone
deletion.danger: Zone deletion is permanent. All zone metadata, service configuration, and audit history will be removed.
precond: Transition through the state machine to disabled
Deregister all dataplane clusters from the zone
Disable all 5 services: hypervisor, storage, mail, k8s, ai
workflow: Drain all workloads from the zone
Deregister all dataplane cluster(s) from the zone
Disable all zone services (hypervisor, storage, mail, k8s, ai)
Navigate to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone
Confirm deletion in the dialog — this action cannot be undone

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting

items.title: Cannot transition zone to active
items.cause: Zone is in planned status but no dataplane is registered.
items.solution: Register a dataplane cluster first. Zone can only transition to active after a healthy dataplane node is attached.

items.title: Cannot update zone services
items.cause: Zone is in active, draining, or disabled status.
items.solution: Transition zone to maintenance status first, then update services.

items.title: Cannot delete zone
items.cause: One or more preconditions not met — status not disabled, dataplane still attached, or services still enabled.
items.solution: Check all 3 preconditions in Section 4 and run through the deletion workflow step-by-step.

items.title: Zone stuck in draining
items.cause: Long-running workloads are preventing drain completion.
items.solution: Check active workloads on the zone. Force-terminate stalled workloads if safe to do so, then retry the drain.

troubleshooting.help: Contact the infrastructure team or check the controlplane logs via Grafana → Loki.

hero.title: Zone Creation Workflow
hero.subtitle: End-to-end guide: from planning to zone active serving traffic

planning.title: Planning
checklist: Confirm zone code does not already exist
Choose geographic location matching latency target
Identify required service set for this zone
Prepare dataplane node with correct capabilities
Have Admin API key with valid MFA
table: Service set to enable from the start
Node to register into this zone

create.title: Create Zone
create.intro: There are 2 ways to create a zone: via Admin UI or directly via API.
ui_steps: Go to Admin UI → Zones → Add Zone
Fill in Zone Name, Zone Code, and select Location from autocomplete
create.result: Zone is created with status: planned. Zone ID (UUIDv7) will be used in subsequent steps.

dataplane.title: Register Dataplane
dataplane.warning: Zone cannot transition to active if no dataplane node is registered and healthy.
table: Must match ZONE_ID in dataplane env
List of services the node supports
Must include all services enabled in the zone
verify: Go to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone → Dataplanes
Confirm node appears with status connected
Check Grafana → Metrics: dataplane_heartbeat_total is incrementing

activate.title: Activate Zone
prereq: At least 1 dataplane node registered and healthy
ui_steps: Go to Admin UI → Zones → Select zone
activate.result: Zone starts accepting traffic immediately after transitioning to active. Controlplane will begin routing workloads to this zone.

verify.title: Verify & Monitor
verify.grafana: Open Grafana → Dashboards → Zone Overview to see all metrics for the new zone. Filter by label zone_id.

rollback.title: Rollback
rollback.when: Rollback when the new zone causes unexpected errors: dataplane cannot connect, service not healthy, or workloads fail after routing to the new zone.
steps: Transition zone to draining — stop accepting new workloads
Wait for current workloads to complete or migrate to another zone
Investigate root cause via Grafana Loki + Tempo
Fix the issue, then transition back to active or delete zone if no longer needed
rollback.help: Contact the infrastructure team with zone ID and incident timestamp. Check logs at Grafana → Loki.
